scripts.translation:
[學者]
恭喜。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
It takes a lifetime...
Literally a lifetime
to amass the knowledge
necessary to become
a Scholar...
scripts.translation:
[學者]
這需要一生...真的是一生，才能積累成為學者所需的知識...

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
It's overwhelming.
The more you learn, the
more you discover what
else you don't know.
There's no end to the
process of learning...
scripts.translation:
[學者]
真是令人感慨。
學得越多，就越能發現自己的無知。
求知之路，永無止境...

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Midgard doesn't
have enough Scholars to
help usher in a new age
of prosperity. The
world needs you...
scripts.translation:
[學者]
米德加爾特需要更多學者，幫助世人迎來繁榮的新時代。
這個世界需要你...

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Will you take this
awesome responsibility?
Will you serve Midgard
as a Scholar?
scripts.translation:
[學者]
你願意肩負這份重任，以學者的身份為米德加爾特效力嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[學者]
準備好了，隨時回來吧。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
你還有可以學習的技能。
請用完剩餘的技能點，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Congratulations!
As a Professor, I hope
that you will take an
active part in bringing
the light of knowledge
where there is darkness.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
恭喜！
願你身為智者，積極將知識之光帶到黑暗之處。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[學者]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向勇士們致敬！
